name.description: The name of the OTS instance.

i18n.en-US: The name of the OTS instance.

description.description: A brief description of the OTS instance.

i18n.en-US: A brief description of the OTS instance.

table_schemas.description: Map of table names to their primary key definitions (key=name, value=type)

i18n.zh-Hans: 表名到其主键定义的映射（键为表名，值为主键类型）
i18n.en-US: Map of table names to their primary key definitions (key=name, value=type)

time_to_live.description: The retention time of data stored in this table (unit: second). -1 means never expired.

i18n.zh-Hans: 该表中存储的数据的保留时间（单位：秒），-1 表示永不过期。
i18n.en-US: The retention time of data stored in this table (in seconds). A value of -1 means the data never expires.

max_version.description: The maximum number of versions stored in this table.

i18n.zh-Hans: 此表中存储的版本最大数量。
i18n.en-US: The maximum number of versions stored in this table.

deviation_cell_version_in_sec.description: The max version offset of the table.

i18n.en-US: The maximum version offset of the table.

attach_vpc.description: Whether to attach a VPC to the OTS instance.

i18n.en-US: Whether to attach a VPC to the OTS instance.

vswitch_id.description: The ID of an existing VSwitch to attach (when attach_vpc=true).

i18n.zh-Hans: 要附加的现有虚拟交换机（VSwitch）的ID（当attach_vpc=true时）。
i18n.en-US: The ID of an existing VSwitch to attach (when attach_vpc is true).

vpc_name.description: Name prefix for auto-created VPC/VSwitch (when attach_vpc=true and vswitch_id is not provided).

i18n.zh-Hans: 自动创建VPC/VSwitch时使用的名称前缀（当attach_vpc=true且未提供vswitch_id时）
i18n.en-US: Name prefix for auto-created VPC/VSwitch (used when attach_vpc is true and vswitch_id is not provided).
